The '''Wind Raiders''' were a tribe of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] native to [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]]. While normally peaceful, they became more warlike when [[Genogri]] assumed the title of [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] some [[Time/Legends|time]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Greedy and power-hungry, he transformed the otherwise peaceful people into a fierce warrior people.

The Wind Raiders had domesticated the airborne creatures, known as [[Fleft-wauf/Legends|fleft-waufs]], and lived inside another airborne creature called an [[island-beast]].

In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], they assisted [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in defeating [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces above the planet.

Later, they acquired a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] from a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operative, whom they had killed when he tried to contact them, after having established contact with the [[Denfrandi]]. They kept the starship inside their island beast, but were not able to operate it. They lost the starship again, when other Rebels stranded on Taloraan, aided by the Denfrandi, acquired it and made it off planet.
